method: Direct inspection of two original 1280x720 runtime PNGs

images.observations: The skeletal player, road markings, facade relief and HUD are readable. Repeated architecture, sparse road dressing and open black world edges remain unfinished presentation.
The destroyed panel, orange hazard floor and switch are distinct in the playable street. The scene still uses simple geometry and sparse surface detail; this is not final production art.

limits: Static inspection cannot accept motion, temporal stability, startup smoothness or audio.
No game asset or art source changed in this experiment.
